summary: High Tide Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the opening of two new Canna Cabana retail locations in Welland, Ontario and Calgary, Alberta. The openings are part of the company's organic retail expansion and do not involve transaction terms, board recommendations, advisors, or deal mechanics. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation. The filing is a routine operational update from a foreign private issuer.
